prompts.name: terrain-painted-r3.png
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production texture atlas for a top-down 2D gothic fantasy survival game, Echo Witch. Create ONE square image divided EXACTLY into a 2 by 2 grid of four square seamless terrain textures, edge to edge, no gutters or borders. These are flat overhead walkable ground materials, with no upright objects, no perspective, no characters, no UI, no text, no lighting baked from a dramatic direction. Style: lavishly hand-painted dark fairytale illustration with fine ink edge accents, natural worn material variation, substantial material detail and quiet low-contrast values suitable behind small characters, matching a moonlit gothic rose garden and ivory/violet witch illustration. Top-left square: irregular old grey limestone paving, damp teal moss in narrow cracks, tiny fallen ivory rose petals, restrained desaturated forest green and slate. Top-right square: old blue-grey slate flagstones of an enchanted archive with occasional narrow dark worn wood strips, faint reflected cool moonlight, soft dusty patina, restrained navy and muted blue. Bottom-left square: ancient bell tower grey stone flagstones with sparse thin aged brass inlays and worn circular engraving fragments, muted charcoal and umber gold, very little contrast. Bottom-right square: neutral very dark stone paving with moss and a few weathered cracks, for a quiet border variation. Each quadrant must be a complete uniform repeatable texture. Keep stones scaled consistently across all four panels. No highly bright patches, no isolated focal objects, no pillars, no plants growing upright, no horizon, no decorative outer frame, no checkerboard. Use the full canvas. Professional game material painting with rich texture at close range and restful readability when reduced.
